item.title: Realtek rtl819x Jungle SDK Unauthenticated Kernel Memory R/W via Debug IOCTLs (CVE-2026-36355)
item.description:

Affected Target

Field Value
Software / System Realtek rtl819x “Jungle SDK” out-of-tree Wi-Fi driver (rtl8192cd)
Versions Affected Builds including the unconditional debug IOCTL set
Language / Platform C kernel-interaction PoC
Authentication Required Local (any user able to open a wireless interface backed by the driver)
Network Access Required No

Summary

The rtl8192cd Wi-Fi kernel driver in Realtek’s out-of-tree rtl819x “Jungle SDK” exposes two IOCTLs — write_mem (0x89F5) and read_mem (0x89F6) — with no access-control checks. These debug handlers are gated only by a macro (_IOCTL_DEBUG_CMD_) that is defined unconditionally rather than behind #ifdef DEBUG, so the debug command set ships in production builds. Any local user able to open the wireless network interface can read or write arbitrary kernel virtual memory, leading directly to root.
